title: Payment Protection Benefit Schedule
content:
Payment Protection benefits are paid to the protected loan. This schedule sets the amount of a death benefit and of one monthly benefit, and how and when benefits are paid.

## Benefit amounts by plan

| Plan | Largest death benefit per plan | Largest monthly disability or unemployment benefit |
|---|---|---|
| Payment Protection Life | USD 50000.00 | not covered |
| Payment Protection Life and Disability | USD 50000.00 | USD 1500.00 |
| Payment Protection Complete | USD 50000.00 | USD 1500.00 |
| Joint Payment Protection Life | USD 50000.00 | not covered |
| Joint Payment Protection Life and Disability | USD 50000.00 | USD 1500.00 |
| Joint Payment Protection Complete | USD 50000.00 | USD 1500.00 |

## Benefit terms common to all six plans

| Term | Value for every plan |
|---|---|
| What a death benefit pays | the unpaid principal and accrued interest on the date of death, up to the maximum death benefit, which pays the loan off up to that amount |
| Amount of one monthly disability or unemployment benefit | the loan's scheduled installment on the loss date, up to the maximum monthly benefit |
| When a monthly benefit is paid | on each loan due date in the benefit period, posted to the loan as a payment of the protection benefit type |
| Benefit paid for a month the covered person was no longer disabled or unemployed | reversed, and the loan payment it funded is returned |
| Monthly benefit for a due date deferred by a hardship plan (no installment is due then) | not paid |

## Hypothetical illustrations

The figures below are invented to show how the caps work; they are not schedule values except where the cap is named.

- *Monthly benefit above the cap.* A loan whose scheduled installment on the loss date is a hypothetical USD 1,800.00, on Payment Protection Complete: the monthly benefit is USD 1500.00, the largest monthly benefit.
- *Monthly benefit below the cap.* A scheduled installment of a hypothetical USD 400.00 on the loss date, on Payment Protection Life and Disability: the monthly benefit is USD 400.00.
- *Death benefit within the cap.* A hypothetical unpaid principal of USD 20,000.00 and accrued interest of USD 100.00 on the date of death: the death benefit is USD 20,100.00, their total, which is below USD 50000.00 and pays the loan off.
- *Death benefit above the cap.* A hypothetical unpaid principal and accrued interest totalling USD 56,000.00 on the date of death: the death benefit is USD 50000.00, which pays the loan off up to that amount.
